declared_limitations: Generated source is a material drawing, not a metrically accurate reconstruction. Source corner measurements have approximately 2-pixel visual uncertainty.
The empty crate is an open shell: outer width .40m, depth .30m, top .10m, floor top .015m, wood .012m. There is no full opaque plane at Y=.10.
Only two exterior near faces and two interior far faces are rendered for the fixed 30/45 view. Hidden reverse faces are not recovered.
Floor uses a wholly visible interior wood patch as UV material over the physical floor. This is material reuse, not reconstruction of occluded original floor pixels.

Far-wall lower side endpoints are inferred from the observed back vertical drop. The near exterior walls occlude these portions by the common depth test; no source assurance is claimed for occluded pixels.
Rim rectangular strips use observed border quads as wood material and overlap at physical corners. They are not an assertion that the drawn caps have exactly .012m thickness.
No per-part origin shift, silhouette ground shift, resized source PNG, or additional generation. Existing project_faces nearest sampling and alpha>=128 policy applies.
